title: Fix: the path that doesn't fit
hints: It only crashes when the function has to add a `/` itself. Count the bytes `path_join("logs", "a.txt")` writes and compare that with what it asked `malloc` for.
The allocation covers the directory, the name and the `'\0'`, but not the separator. Whenever `need_slash` is true, the final `memcpy` writes one byte past the end of the block.
Include the separator in the size: `malloc(dir_len + need_slash + name_len + 1)` (a `bool` is 0 or 1, so it adds exactly the byte you need).
